name: steady-tone
task: low mood in a short message (any of: sadness, grief, disappointment, remorse)
trained_on: GoEmotions simplified train split (Google, Apache-2.0); Reddit comments
tokenizer: 1) lowercase A-Z only; 2) delete apostrophes (U+0027, U+2018, U+2019, U+0060, U+02BC); 3) squash any letter a-z repeated 3 or more times to 2 (regex ([a-z])\1{2,} -> $1$1); 4) tokens = runs of [a-z0-9]; 5) features = tokens plus each adjacent pair of tokens joined by one space. TF-IDF uses the vocab below, idf as given, tf as given, then L2 normalization over the vocab features present; score = sigmoid(intercept + coef . x).
